media.caption: These models use short-lived plant samples and illustrate alternative calendar placements. The two groups do not show people occupying the village continuously between them. The paper adds other constraints to prefer a later range; this figure alone is not that final result. Both panels and axes are preserved.
notice: Find the separated groups near 1500 and 1600.
Why would two possible dates differ from a century-long occupation?
